DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 取引明細についてのご相談ですね。必要な期間を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss transaction statements. Please tell me the period you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社への提出用に三月から五月までと思っていましたが、この案内を見ると四月から六月でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 提出案内を読み直して必要な明細期間を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I needed March through May to submit to my company, but looking at these instructions, it was April through June.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Reread the submission instructions and correct the required statement period. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ申込み前ですので、必要な期間を確認しましょう。この案内の提出対象はこちらの口座ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not applied yet, so let's check the period you need. Is this the account covered by these submission instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、給与を受け取るこの口座です。別の口座の明細を混ぜないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 給与口座の明細だけが必要だと区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, this is the account where I receive my salary. I want to avoid mixing in statements from another account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that you only need statements for your salary account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人と口座を確認したうえで、出せる明細と申込み方法をご案内します。提出先が指定する項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: After verifying your identity and account, we will explain which statements can be issued and how to apply. Does the recipient require particular items?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前と取引の日付が必要と書いてあります。銀行で出せる書類に両方あるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出に必要な氏名と取引日が書類に載るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says my name and the transaction dates are required. I would like to know whether the documents the bank can issue include both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the documents include the name and transaction dates required for submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類の種類を担当者に確認します。発行にかかる日数や費用も、その際にご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the document types with the officer. We will also explain the processing time and fees then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 提出日は来週ですが、今日受け取れるとは考えず、発行時期を聞いてから会社に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 明細の発行時期を確認後に会社へ連絡すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The submission date is next week, but I won't assume I can receive them today. I'll contact my company after asking when they can be issued.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to contact your company after checking when the statements will be issued. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それがよいですね。期間や書類を間違えると取り直しになるので、申込み欄も一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: That sounds sensible. An incorrect period or document would mean obtaining it again, so let's also check the application fields together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 四月から六月と書きました。書類の内容と受取時期を聞いてから申込みを確定します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正した期間を示して書類条件確認後に申込みを確定すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written April through June. I'll finalize the application after asking about the document contents and when I can receive them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the corrected period and say you will finalize the application after checking the document requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では担当へご案内します。こちらでは失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take you to the officer now. I will leave you with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値札を探していらっしゃいますか。どの商品でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a price label? Which product is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この洗剤です。安いと思って取りましたが、棚の値札と袋の容量が違っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手に取った洗剤の容量と棚の値札が違うと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This detergent. I picked it up because I thought it was cheap, but the capacity on the shelf label differs from the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the detergent bag you picked up has a different capacity from the shelf price label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 値札はこちらの小さい袋用ですね。今お持ちの大きい袋は、隣の棚に対応する値札があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This price label is for the smaller bag here. The large bag you are holding has its corresponding label on the next shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見間違えていました。大きい袋の値段と、何回分かを比べてから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大きい詰替袋の価格と使用量を比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I misread it. I'd like to compare the large bag's price and how many uses it provides before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to compare the large refill bag's price and the amount of use it provides. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 値段はこちらです。何回使えるかは使う量にもよりますので、袋の使用量の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The price is here. How many times you can use it also depends on the amount used, so please check the usage amounts on the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家の容器に詰め替えたいので、同じシリーズかも確認できますか。容器の写真はあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自宅容器の写真を示して詰替製品のシリーズを確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to refill the container at home, so could you also check whether it is the same series? I have a photo of the container.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show a photo of your container at home and check the refill product's series. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真の名前と袋の名前を見比べましょう。違う製品を混ぜないよう、容器の注意書きも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's compare the name in the photo with the name on the bag. Please also check the container's precautions so that you do not mix different products.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ名前ですが、香りが違いました。元と同じ香りの小さい袋を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 容器と香りが違うことに気づいて元と同じ製品を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The name is the same, but the scent was different. I'll look for a small bag with the same scent as the original.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Notice the scent differs from the container's product and look for the original product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じ香りはこちらの段です。値札の容量も袋と合っているか、もう一度ご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The same scent is on this shelf. Please check again that the capacity on the price label also matches the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回はこの小さい袋にします。容量も香りも、家の容器に合うことを確認できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 値札の容量と容器に合う香りを確認して小袋を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose this small bag this time. I have confirmed that both the capacity and scent suit the container at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the label's capacity and a scent matching your container, then choose the small bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お選びいただけてよかったです。ありがとうございました、どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad you found one. Thank you, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その先は通路の工事中です。赤い柵の内側には入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The path ahead is under construction. Please do not enter the area inside the red fence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池のそばのベンチで友人を待つ予定です。この道が通れないなら、別の道がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通路工事を踏まえて池の待ち合わせ場所への別経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I planned to wait for a friend on a bench beside the pond. If this path is closed, is there another way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for an alternative route to your pond meeting place given the path construction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 池へは反対側から回れますが、距離が延びます。友人の方と連絡は取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can reach the pond from the opposite side, but it is farther. Can you contact your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話できます。友人はまだ公園の外なので、入口で待ち合わせることに変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 公園外にいる友人と入口で会う計画へ変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can call. My friend is still outside the park, so I'd like to change our meeting place to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Change your plan to meet your friend, who is outside the park, at the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、いま来られた入口の案内板が目印になります。車の出入りがある場所は避けて待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, the information board at the entrance you came through is a good landmark. Please avoid waiting where vehicles enter and leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内板の横にいると伝えます。工事の車が通る道は、この舗装された道ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口の目印を選んで工事車両の通る道を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell my friend I'm beside the information board. Is this paved road the route used by construction vehicles?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a landmark at the entrance and check which road construction vehicles use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、その道を横切らず、歩行者用の通路から入口へお戻りください。柵で分けた部分には近づかないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Do not cross that road; return to the entrance along the pedestrian path. Please keep away from the area separated by the fence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 歩行者用の通路を戻ります。友人にも池へ向かわず入口に来るよう連絡しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 歩行者通路で戻り友人にも入口へ来るよう伝えたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll return along the pedestrian path. I have also contacted my friend to come to the entrance instead of heading to the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you will return along the pedestrian path and have told your friend to come to the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口に着いたら、通行の邪魔にならない位置でお待ちください。友人の方からの返事も確認しておくと安心ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you reach the entrance, wait somewhere that does not obstruct traffic. Checking your friend's reply would also be reassuring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返事が来ました。案内板を目印に、二人が会ってから散歩の行き先を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人の返信を確認して合流後に散歩先を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received a reply. We'll use the information board as our landmark and decide where to walk after we meet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your friend's reply and say you will decide where to walk after meeting up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無事に会えるとよいですね。どうぞお気をつけて、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope you meet without difficulty. Take care; I'll leave you now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 往復の切符をご希望ですね。お帰りも今日の予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like a return ticket. Are you planning to return today too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰る列車は夜遅いので、着くのは明日の朝になりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 復路の到着が翌朝になりそうだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The train back is late at night, so I will probably arrive tomorrow morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you will probably arrive on the return journey the following morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 出発日と到着日を分けて確認しましょう。帰りに乗る列車は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the departure and arrival dates separately. Have you decided which train you will take back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人との用事が終わる時刻次第なので、まだ決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用事の終了時刻が未定で復路列車を決められないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It depends on when I finish what I'm doing with my friend, so I can't decide yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot choose the return train because you do not know when your plans will finish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、まず行きの列車を決めて、帰りの候補は時刻表で見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, let's choose your outbound train first, then look at return options in the timetable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 行きは午後の普通列車にします。帰りの最終候補だけメモできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 往路を選び復路の最終候補の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll take an afternoon local train outward. Could I note down just the latest return option?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose your outbound train and ask to check the latest return option. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの時刻表で確認できます。乗換えがある候補には印を付けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check it in this timetable. I will mark the options that require a transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乗換えに間に合わなかった場合は、途中の駅で泊まることになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗換えに遅れた場合の宿泊の可能性を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I miss the connection, will I have to stay overnight at a station along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the possibility of staying overnight if you miss the connection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その可能性はありますから、接続時間も見て予定を立ててください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is possible, so please consider the connection times when planning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帰りは友人と相談して決めます。今は行きの切符だけ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 復路購入を保留し往路だけ購入すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll discuss the return journey with my friend before deciding. For now, I'll buy only the outbound ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to postpone buying the return ticket and purchase only the outbound ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、行きの内容をご確認ください。お気をつけて、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please check the outbound details. Take care, and have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの通知について、どの点をご確認になりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which point would you like to check about the notice you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所は私の部屋ですが、宛名が知らない人の名前になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自宅住所に他人宛ての通知が届いたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The address is my apartment, but it is addressed to someone I don't know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a notice addressed to someone else arrived at your home address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の通知とは限りませんね。封筒の差出課を確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: It may not be your notice. May I check the sending department on the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ開封していません。差出人は、この面に書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒を開けておらず差出人の表示があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't opened it. The sender is written on this side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not opened the envelope and that the sender is indicated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ここにある課の窓口へ、封筒のままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. Please take it, still in the envelope, to the counter for the department listed here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私が代わりに書類を出す必要はないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分が代理で提出する必要はないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I don't need to submit the documents on that person's behalf?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you do not need to submit it as a representative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中身を確認して代理で手続きするのではなく、宛名の相違を担当課に伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the department about the different addressee, rather than checking the contents and handling the procedure on their behalf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当課では、今の入居日も伝えたほうがいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当課へ入居日を伝えるべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Should I also tell the department when I moved in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should tell the department your move-in date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かる範囲でお伝えください。前の住人の個人情報を調べる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell them what you know. There is no need to investigate the previous resident's personal information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 封を開けずに持って行き、今月入居したことと宛名の違いを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未開封の通知を持って宛名と入居時期を説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take it unopened and explain that I moved in this month and that the addressee is different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take the unopened notice and explain the addressee and when you moved in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当課はこの先の案内表示に沿ってお進みください。では、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Follow the signs ahead to that department. I'll leave you now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の服用中のお薬の欄が空いていますが、何かお飲みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: The current medication field on your medical questionnaire is blank. Are you taking anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今朝、市販の風邪薬を飲みました。名前はこの箱に書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今朝飲んだ市販薬の箱を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took an over-the-counter cold medicine this morning. The name is on this box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the box of the over-the-counter medicine you took this morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱を確認させてください。飲んだ量と時刻も覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I check the box? Do you remember the amount and time you took it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二錠です。時刻は出勤の前でしたが、正確には思い出せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 服用量は分かるが正確な時刻は不明だと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two tablets. It was before work, but I can't remember the exact time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you know the dose but not the exact time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分からない時刻を推測して書かず、おおよその時間だと分かるようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not guess and write down a time you do not know. Let's make clear that it is approximate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出勤前に家族へ送ったメッセージを見れば、もう少し絞れそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族へのメッセージで服用時刻を絞ると提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I look at the message I sent my family before work, I may be able to narrow it down a little more.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suggest narrowing down the medication time using your message to your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できた範囲を記入してください。他にも飲んだ薬はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Write what you can confirm. Have you taken any other medicine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨夜の薬も同じ箱から飲みました。その分も別に書いたほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昨夜の同じ薬の服用も記入するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Last night's medicine was from the same box. Should I write that dose separately too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should also record taking the same medicine last night. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 昨夜の分も記入し、不明な点は診察で医師へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Write last night's dose too, and tell the doctor anything unclear during the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 量と分かる時刻を書き足して、分からない部分はそのまま相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 分かる情報を補足し不明な点は診察で相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll add the amount and the times I know, and discuss the parts I don't know without filling them in by guesswork.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will add the information you know and discuss unknown points during the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 診察室へご案内するまで、こちらでお待ちください。では、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here until we take you to the consultation room. I'll leave you for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾得物をお持ちですね。どちらで見つけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought a found item. Where did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鍵の束を、バス停の近くで拾いました。名前の札は付いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 名前札のない鍵の束をバス停近くで拾ったと届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I picked up a bunch of keys near the bus stop. There is no name tag attached.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report finding a bunch of keys without a name tag near a bus stop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: バス停の待合場所に落ちていたということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you mean they were lying in the bus stop's waiting area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 待合場所ではなく、横断歩道を渡った先の歩道です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待合場所ではなく横断歩道の先だったと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not in the waiting area, but on the pavement after crossing the pedestrian crossing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct that it was beyond the crossing, rather than in the waiting area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの地図で位置を確かめましょう。交差点のどちら側ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the location on this map. Which side of the intersection?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 海のほうへ曲がる角です。地図では、この印の辺りになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曲がる方向と地図の位置で発見場所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The corner where you turn toward the sea. On the map, it is around this mark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the discovery location using the direction of the turn and the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 位置を記録します。鍵は拾ったときから、この状態でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record the location. Were the keys in this condition when you picked them up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、この輪に三本付いていました。落ちていた物には触らず、その束だけ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵の本数と拾ったときの状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, three keys were attached to this ring. I did not touch the other things lying there and brought only that bunch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the number of keys and their condition when found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。拾った時刻もお伺いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I will also ask what time you found them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昼休みの十二時半ごろです。場所の説明がずれていたら、ここで直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見時刻を答え場所の説明を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Around twelve thirty during my lunch break. If my description of the place was inaccurate, I'd like to correct it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the discovery time and say you want to check your description of the location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今のお話と地図の位置で確認できました。お届けいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed it from your explanation and the map location. Thank you for bringing them in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所の記入でお困りですか。まだ提出前でしたら確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having difficulty writing the address? If you haven't submitted it yet, let's check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旧住所の建物名だけ思い出せません。部屋番号は二〇三です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧住所の建物名を思い出せないが部屋番号は分かると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I just can't remember the building name in my old address. The apartment number is 203.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot remember the old address's building name but know the apartment number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 以前の住所が載った書類や、郵便物はお手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have any documents or mail showing your previous address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日はありませんが、家に古い賃貸契約書を保管しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 古い賃貸契約書を自宅に保管していると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not with me today, but I keep the old rental agreement at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you keep the old rental agreement at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それで表記を確認してから記入してください。今の住所は分かっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the spelling there before filling it in. Do you know your current address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新住所はこのメモの通りです。旧住所の建物名を空欄で出してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新住所は分かると伝え旧住所の空欄提出を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The new address is as written in this note. Can I submit it with the old building name left blank?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you know the new address and ask about submitting the old address with a blank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不足があるまま提出せず、確認してからお持ちになるのがよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would be better to check first and bring it back, rather than submitting it with missing information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約書と以前の郵便物で建物名の書き方が違ったら、どちらを見せればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料間で建物名の表記が違う場合の確認方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the building name is written differently on the agreement and old mail, which should I show you?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to check if the building name is written differently across documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 両方の表記をお持ちいただければ、担当者が確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you bring both versions, the officer can check them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は用紙を持ち帰って二つを調べます。分からなければ、提出前に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出を延期し資料を調べて不明点を相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the form home today and check both. If I'm still unsure, I'll ask before submitting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to postpone submission, examine the documents, and discuss anything unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できた資料も一緒にお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring the documents you were able to check too. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所変更の用紙をお預かりします。送付先の欄はこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll take your address-change form. Is this mailing address field correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あ、その欄に勤務先を書いてしまいました。自宅へ送ってほしいんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送付先に勤務先を誤記し自宅送付を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oh, I wrote my workplace in that field. I want the mail sent to my home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you mistakenly entered your workplace as the mailing address and want home delivery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、登録住所と送付先の欄を分けて確認しましょう。新しいご自宅の住所はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then let's check the registered address and mailing address fields separately. What is your new home address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらの書類にあります。勤務先の住所は、連絡先を聞かれたと思って書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自宅住所の書類を示し連絡先欄を誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's on this document. I wrote my workplace address because I thought you were asking for contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the document with your home address and explain your misunderstanding of the contact field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この欄は郵送物の送付先です。記入を直す方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This field is for the postal mailing address. I'll explain how to correct it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書き直す前に、電話番号の欄も見てもらえますか。会社の番号を入れたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話番号欄にも勤務先番号を入れた可能性を伝えて確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Before I rewrite it, could you check the telephone field too? I may have entered my company's number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you may also have entered your workplace number and ask for the telephone field to be checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここに書かれた番号は、ご本人につながる番号でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is the number written here one that reaches you personally?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社の代表番号でした。自分の携帯番号に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社の代表番号から本人の携帯へ変更したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was the company's main number. I'd like to change it to my mobile number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to change the company's main number to your own mobile number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。用紙の指定された方法で、住所と番号を修正してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please correct the address and number using the method specified on the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 修正しました。申請する前に、自宅住所と携帯番号をもう一度読み合わせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 修正後の自宅住所と携帯番号の読み合わせを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've corrected them. Before applying, I'd like to read back my home address and mobile number together once more.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to read back the corrected home address and mobile number together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今の読み合わせで、修正した内容を確認できました。では、用紙をお預かりします、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed the corrections by reading them back just now. I'll take the form, then. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お菓子をお選びですか。お手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you choosing sweets? Is there anything I can help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場で一つずつ配りたいんですが、この袋の中は個包装ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場で配る菓子が個包装か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to hand them out one each at work. Are the contents of this bag individually wrapped?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether sweets for handing out at work are individually wrapped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外袋の説明では個包装となっています。中の袋にどんな表示があるかは確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The outer bag says they are individually wrapped. We would need to check what information is on the inner wrappers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 配る相手にも原材料を見てもらいたいので、内袋に書いてあるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配布相手が読める原材料表示が内袋にあるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want the recipients to be able to read the ingredients too, so I'd like to know whether they are on the inner wrappers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the inner wrappers have ingredient labels that recipients can read. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この外袋だけでは、内袋の表示まで分かりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This outer bag alone does not tell us what is printed on the inner wrappers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 売り物を開けるのは困ると思います。見本か、メーカーの説明はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封商品を開けず見本やメーカーの説明で確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I think opening merchandise would be a problem. Is there a sample or an explanation from the manufacturer?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check a sample or the manufacturer's explanation without opening unopened merchandise. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 開封済みの見本はありません。メーカーの問い合わせ先はこちらに載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We don't have an opened sample. The manufacturer's contact information is listed here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 人数は八人なので、個別に表示のある小袋を八つ選ぶ方法もありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 八人分を表示のある小袋で用意する案を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are eight people, so another option would be to choose eight small bags, each with its own label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Suggest preparing eight individually labeled small bags for eight people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの小袋には、それぞれ原材料と期限の表示があります。必要な数を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: These small bags each show the ingredients and expiry information. Please check how many you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回はこの小袋を八つにします。表示を残したまま渡せますから。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原材料表示を残して渡せる小袋八つを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take eight of these small bags this time. I can hand them over with the labels still attached.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose eight small bags that can be handed out with the ingredient labels intact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 八袋ですね。お会計の際に数もお確かめください、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Eight bags, then. Please check the count at checkout too. Thank you.
